notes.title: New DX version to celebrate new game ChainStaff.
notes.notes:
I'm releasing all the DX content for free to players who already own the game!
This is to celebrate the reveal of my next game:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/[/url]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766[/img]
[h2]Please [b]wishlist [/b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]ChainStaff[/url][/i] today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games. As a thank you--here's all the new DX content for Game Type![/h2]

Game Type DX now has new levels, new enemies, and new modes! Tons of extra content, all super easy to jump in, play a few rounds, and show up on the global leaderboards. 

[list]
[*] 3 Game modes: "Standard", "Parkour Remix", and "Surprise!"
[*] “Surprise!” game mode features new level layouts every time you play.
[*] Online Leaderboard! Show up often. Show Off your play skills!
[*] The new DX version of the game has lots of powerups and even POWER DOWNS!
[*] DX version also features loads of NEW corny video game jokes to discover in the fake dashboard section.
[/list]

There are several new game modes included in the DX content. One of the most intriguing game modes is aptly named “Surprise!”. In it players are treated to a random assortment of level segments with all new challenges to surmount. Their particular level arrangement then increases in speed each time the player completes it in a single run. The player receives help with the addition of several types of power-ups including those for shooting power, score, and damage. There are even wacky power-downs the player must avoid, or possibly take as they discover the patterns of the game. There are nearly 40 level segments with multiple new enemy types for players to discover in the all-new “Surprise!” mode.

Thank you for playing Game Type DX and as always:
PARKOUR!

-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games

notes.title: XBLIG Escapees: Mommy s Best Games On PC
notes.notes:
Xbox Live Indie Games has felt like an outpost of PC gaming on Xbox 360. It’s a space like Newgrounds, Game Jolt, or Itch, where anyone can make and release small games, which means its library of thousands has everything from scrappy gag games to some really pretty great stuff. And like PC gaming, Microsoft had no idea what to do with XBLIG – they hid the space away for years, and are now planning to close it.

But! Good (and RPS-relevant) news: four games from prolific XBLIG dev Mommy’s Best Games – who you might know for the gun-stacking Serious Sam Double D – have arrived on Steam, giving a small peek into the world.

… [visit site to read more]
